in_hebrew.name: Blancha
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Blancha הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'bléchas', meaning 'white, fair'. In Greek mythology, Blancha was an alternate name for the goddess Persephone, who was associated with the springtime and the rebirth of plants. In Christianity, the name Blancha is a feminine variant of the name Blaise, which is derived from the Latin word 'blasius', meaning 'praiseworthy'.
